description: Currency -> USD conversion rates, used to normalise scraped retail prices onto one comparable scale. Distinct from Costing Currency, whose conversion_factor is INR-based and precision-2.

fields.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. INR. Stored uppercase.
fields.label: Currency Code

fields.description: Symbol as it appears in scraped price text, e.g. ₹. Used to detect which currency a raw price string is in.
fields.label: Currency Symbol

fields.description: USD per 1 unit of this currency. USD itself is 1. Multiply an amount in this currency by this to get USD.
fields.label: Rate to USD

fields.description: When this rate was last sourced. Shown alongside any figure derived from it so a stale rate is visible rather than silent.
fields.label: Rate As Of

name: Currency Rate
